description: Fontaines à boire (Marseille et Allauch) - Gestion métropolitaine is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Localisation des fontaines à boire (eau potable) sur la voierie, avec modèle et état de fonctionnement, recensées par les services de la métropole. Les fontaines installées dans les parcs et jardins publics ne sont pas disponibles dans ce jeu de donnée (gestion communale). Points collectés sur le terrain à l'aide d'un smartphone. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Aménagement. Its keywords are fontaine, eau, eau potable, boire, point d'eau. The portal shows 142 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
